title.en: Run in PRs and in the Queue

hints.tr: `on:` altında `push:` ile aynı hizada `pull_request:` ve onun altında `branches: [main]`.
hints.en: Under `on:`, at the same level as `push:`, `pull_request:` with `branches: [main]` under it.

hints.tr: `merge_group:` ayarsız yazılır: iki noktadan sonra hiçbir şey yok.
hints.en: `merge_group:` is written without settings: nothing after the colon.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  merge_group:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python -m pip install ruff
      - run: python -m ruff check .
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python: ["3.12", "3.13"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
      - run: python -m pip install pytest
      - run: python -m pytest -q
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  merge_group:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python -m pip install ruff
      - run: python -m ruff check .
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python: ["3.12", "3.13"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
      - run: python -m pip install pytest
      - run: python -m pytest -q
```
